d: Indonesia is facing a major surveillance scandal after authorities uncovered an alleged spying operation within the country’s own police force. The alleged targets reportedly included journalists, politicians, business leaders, cabinet ministers and even President Prabowo Subianto. Three senior police officers have been arrested, including former national police chief and presidential chief of staff Listyo Sigit Prabowo, who has since been removed from his post.
